source_outcomes.Miss: outcomes bit1, prioritized return; original INGAME_ATTACK_MISS localized Miss, anim_sct_block, MissColor
source_outcomes.Dodge: outcomes bit2 after Miss, prioritized return; localized Dodge
source_outcomes.Block: outcomes bit4; localized Block can be followed by numeric partial damage
source_outcomes.Critical: outcomes bit8 chooses crit styles; damage color reflects target player flag
source_outcomes.Zero: raw amount<=0 suppresses numeric event but never generates MISS/BLOCK merely from zero. Positive raw amount<256 legitimately displays source integer0.
source_outcomes.Numeric: Original requested amount >>8, not float health_removed. Source frame positions use target GetTargetPosition plus relative bounds height, and query attacker GetTargetPosition as source does.
source_outcomes.Other: Follower suppresses all; fear/slow source property scaled-word gates retained; dual/offhand and DOT masks preserve actual original style selection.

presentation.interval_policy: Original update uses strict timer>interval. During source load phases2..26 interval33; otherwise int1000/source_fps. Caller supplies actual phase-selected interval.
presentation.font_glyphs: Source Font512 has zero embedded glyphs; genuine Fontin SmallCaps FreeType2.3.7 raster supplies advances/bearings, source SWF layout metrics supply centered field baseline.
presentation.motion: All200 actual source placement matrices exported, including source critical scale and left/right motion. Camera projects once when enqueued as original Flash queue does. Viewport rescaling follows source HUD coordinates.
presentation.fade: Native CombatFlashSwf draw overrides text cxform after goto_frame. Alpha multiplier1 plus ARGB alpha saturates source field alpha; presenter preserves glyph coverage and does not invent a linear fade. Finite source frame_count expires each label.
presentation.ownership: Owned text/glyph quads, no original SWF clone ownership copied. Saturated style-specific8 clone aliasing/stale-text quirks are not duplicated; strings>46 reject explicitly.

original_art: No generated images, system-font substitution, recolor or imagegen. Exact original font and SWF authoring metadata used.
